added_parities.deriving: A preceding nonzero sharing is that self's prior now; an already incoming inverse remains present when further parities are appended at sharing s, so 14 can be inverse or parting but cannot be solely the matching prior, and 12 inverts alike; unchanged sharings preserve the same network inputs next, allowing this reasoning again.
